'''"Coruscant" Erragh''' was a [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] warrior fighting on the side of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Battle of Ilum]], where he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperials]].
